name: Murray River
reason: Long linear feature, not a place (rule 3); its places (Mildura, Echuca, Swan Hill) are judged separately.
objection: Wikivoyage region page is a real guide and paddle steamers draw visitors, but the river itself has no single visit point.

name: Lock 11
reason: One Wikivoyage listing (opened): island walking tracks, swimming sandbars, watching paddle steamers lock through; about half an hour.
objection: Single source, modest draw; could be seen as a park by the river.

name: Apex Park
reason: Wikivoyage (opened) calls it Victoria's largest inland beach with a swimming sandbar; second-tier beach stop.
objection: One source, local riverside park for Mildura residents.

name: Meeting of the Waters
reason: Wikivoyage Mildura lists the Murray-Darling confluence at Wentworth; named natural landmark with riverside viewpoint.
objection: One source, a short look, and it sits across the border in NSW; park viewpoint only.

name: Woodsies Gem Shop
reason: Wikivoyage (opened) describes a shop with maze and display room; fails rule 2 as a commercial shop/cafe, though the maze is a minor draw.
objection: Garden maze and fossil display could fill 30 minutes for families; still a shop.

name: Australian Inland Botanic Gardens
reason: Wikivoyage (opened) lists the semi-arid botanic gardens at Buronga; a garden visitors walk, a half-hour or more.
objection: One source, weekday-leaning hours and it lies in NSW; a regional garden few would cross a state for.

name: Mildura Holden Motor Museum
reason: One Wikivoyage listing, limited weekday hours, small niche museum; fails the friend test.
objection: Real museum open to the public with a clear subject.

name: Trentham Estate
reason: Winery named only in a list; individual cellar door not a distinct draw (rule 3).
objection: Wine is a Sunraysia draw, but one listing line gives nothing to see or do.

name: Oak Valley Estate
reason: Winery named only in a list; individual cellar door not a distinct draw.
objection: Cellar doors can be visited and tasted.

name: Lindemans Mildura
reason: Winery named only in a list; individual cellar door not a distinct draw.
objection: A famous brand, but the listing offers no distinct visit.

name: Mildura Speedway
reason: Recurring race meetings are events, not a permanent draw (rule 4).
objection: Venue exists year-round but is only usable on race nights.

name: Perry Sandhills
reason: No counted source found in Wikivoyage Mildura, Murray River or Swan Hill pages checked; only Wikipedia. Sandboarding dunes near Wentworth (NSW).
objection: Only a Wikipedia source and a sandboarding niche; could be rejected outright.

name: Patchewollock
reason: Wikivoyage Mildura (opened) lists silo mural and a Mallee bird sculpture in a 100-person town; a short roadside look, 141 km from anywhere (judged on content, not location).
objection: Silo art trail stop that guides do name; it is a ten-minute photo stop.

name: Pink Lakes
reason: Visitor guide names the pink salt lakes as a photography draw within Murray-Sunset; a distinct named sight that guides single out.
objection: Could be part of the larger Murray-Sunset National Park spot; only one counted source.

name: Lindsay Island
reason: Picnic area with tables and toilets inside a national park; not a distinct draw (rule 3).
objection: Parks Victoria names it, riverside setting.

name: Shearers' Quarters
reason: Booked accommodation in a park, not a place to drop in (rule 2).
objection: Heritage building, but a stay not a visit.

name: Hattah-Kulkyne National Park
reason: Parks Victoria page (opened) names it: lakes chain, river and bush tracks; a national park is a visit in itself and one agency source is enough for an obvious draw.
objection: Only one counted source and 1,254 views; remote mallee park few travellers know.

name: Wyperfeld National Park
reason: Parks Victoria page names Victoria's first national park with walks and camping; obvious draw for a national park.
objection: One counted source and low views.

name: Lake Tyrrell
reason: Visit Grampians (opened) and Wimmera Mallee tourism pages name Victoria's largest salt lake, with viewing platform and boardwalk; 10,718 views.
objection: Intermittent: appearance depends on water level and light.

name: Dharnya Centre
reason: Wikivoyage Barmah National Park lists the Yorta Yorta cultural centre; a notable cultural stop if open to visitors.
objection: Sits inside Barmah and the listing is thin; may be mainly a camp/education centre.

name: Gunbower National Park
reason: Parks Victoria names the river red gum forest with bend campsites and 4WD tracks; national park.
objection: Mostly camping and 4WD, one source and 674 views.

name: Terrick Terrick National Park
reason: Parks Victoria names a small box-ironbark park with walks and camping.
objection: Small and rarely visited; only one source.

name: Pioneer Settlement
reason: Wikivoyage Swan Hill (opened) lists the 1850s living-history museum with river cruises; full visit.
objection: Dated 'twee' tone, but a headline Swan Hill attraction.

name: Swan Hill Regional Art Gallery
reason: Wikivoyage Swan Hill lists it; free-by-donation regional gallery.
objection: Standard small-town gallery with one source.

name: Swan Hill River Walk
reason: Wikivoyage Swan Hill lists a 4.5 km riverside walk of about two hours, free.
objection: One source; mostly a town riverside path.

name: Burke and Wills Fig Tree
reason: Single tree beside a motel, a short look only; a minor memorial-type stop (rule 3).
objection: Named by Wikivoyage and quirky.

name: Lake Boga Flying Boat Museum
reason: Wikivoyage Swan Hill (opened) lists the restored Catalina and WWII depot, A$18, open daily; a real visit.
objection: Single source, small town.

name: Swan Hill Racecourse
reason: Race meetings are events, not a permanent draw (rule 4).
objection: Course exists year-round.

name: Port of Echuca
reason: Wikivoyage Echuca names the historic wharf, paddle steamers and Discovery Centre; headline attraction of the region.
objection: Only one source in the list, but an obvious draw.

name: Holden Motor Museum Echuca
reason: Wikivoyage Echuca (opened) lists the Holden Motors museum with no detail.
objection: One thin source, niche museum.

name: The Great Aussie Beer Shed
reason: Pub/entertainment venue, not an attraction (rule 2).
objection: Listed under things to do.

name: Shepparton Art Museum
reason: Regional art museum with a major contemporary and ceramics collection, a new building, named by Zoos Victoria and tourism sources; Wikivoyage Shepparton was re-checked and the museum is a Shepparton headline.
objection: No counted source in the original list; I found only secondary press and tourism pages, though visitshepparton.com.au was unreachable (unresolved).

name: Shepparton Communication Tower
reason: Wikivoyage Shepparton (opened) names the free climb to the observation deck.
objection: Short visit and one source; a tower in a mall.

name: KidsTown
reason: Wikivoyage Shepparton (opened) says worth a detour with kids; donation entry, dawn to dusk.
objection: Children only, one source.

name: SPC Ardmona Factory Seconds Outlet
reason: Plain shop (rule 2).
objection: Cheap fruit cans only.

name: Kyabram Fauna Park
reason: Wikivoyage Shepparton (opened) says worth a visit; Zoos Victoria runs it with 600 animals on 55 ha; a full-day wildlife visit.
objection: Half hour drive from Shepparton; entry price unverified.

name: The Cube Wodonga
reason: Theatre venue with shows, not an open attraction (rule 2, 4).
objection: Has a cafe.

name: Rutherglen Wine Region
reason: A region/area, not a place (rule 3); its cellar doors are judged individually.
objection: The region is a real draw for travellers; likely a destination-level matter for the proposer.

name: Rutherglen Loops
reason: Rutherglen tourism itinerary (opened) lists 48 km of trails linking cellar doors and the Murray.
objection: One source, a network not one place.

name: Lake Moodemere
reason: Listed only as a lake near cycling trails with an estate; no distinct activity named.
objection: Lake Moodemere Estate is a winery draw.

name: Muscat Mile De Bortoli Rutherglen Estate
reason: Rutherglen tourism itinerary names the 1886 cellar building and Muscat Mile tasting.
objection: A single winery; one source.

name: Pfeiffer Wines
reason: Rutherglen tourism itinerary names the winery and its iconic sign.
objection: A cellar door, one source; wineries are shops/venues.

name: Scion Wine
reason: Single minimalist cellar door, only a list entry (rule 3).
objection: Rutherglen wine is the region's draw.

name: Yarrawonga Weir
reason: No counted source found in the pages checked (Wikivoyage Yarrawonga page missing); structure is a weir seen from a bridge.
objection: Weir and bridges are a landmark of Yarrawonga.

name: Lake Mulwala
reason: No counted source found; a reservoir with no named visit.
objection: Boating and fishing are big in Yarrawonga.
